name: Vodafone Idea Ltd
tagline: India's third telecom operator with confirmed negative net worth (book value ~-Rs 15/share) and a debt-to-EBITDA of ~13.5x despite FY26 AGR relief and an accounting-driven headline profit - a legitimate AVOID red flag, not a fabricated one.
business_overview: Pan-India mobile telecom operator (Vodafone Idea / 'Vi'). FY26 AGR liability was finalized by DoT at Rs 64,046 Cr, down from a much larger provisional figure, producing a large one-off accounting gain (Ind AS 109 remeasurement, ~Rs 55,622 Cr) and a headline FY26 net profit of ~Rs 34,482 Cr - but this is a non-cash exceptional item, not operating cash generation. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@mystockedge, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_table: Negative - book value ~-Rs 15.03/share; accumulated losses exceeding ~Rs 1.78 lakh Cr
~13.51x - alarmingly high for a capital-intensive telecom operator
~0.54x average recent periods - operating profit covers only ~54% of interest obligations
Revenue ~Rs 44,782 Cr (+2.8% YoY); EBITDA ~Rs 19,003 Cr, margin ~43.1%
Reduced to ~Rs 726 Cr (from ~Rs 2,326 Cr) as of 31 March 2026 - promoter/govt-backed refinancing, not organic deleveraging of the full liability stack
fundamentals_narrative: AGR relief (liability finalized at Rs 64,046 Cr) and fresh promoter-led capital infusion are genuine positives that triggered the recent rally and 52-week-high price action, but they do not resolve the core balance-sheet problem: net worth remains negative (book value ~-Rs 15/share), overall debt-to-EBITDA is ~13.5x, and interest coverage of ~0.54x means operating profit still does not cover interest obligations. The FY26 'net profit' of Rs 34,482 Cr is dominated by a one-off non-cash AGR remeasurement gain, not sustainable operating profitability.
technical_read: Recently hit a 52-week high (~Rs 13.64) on AGR-relief and funding optimism - price momentum reflects sentiment/relief-rally dynamics, not underlying balance-sheet health.
